dct_description_sm:
Location, dates, and outcomes of the Napoleonic Wars. Data were created based on the listings of the battles on wikipedia. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_Napoleonic_era

Dates of the start of the battle are present as are the dates of the end of the battles, when different from the start date and available.

NOTE: The original of the file is held in a google drive table in the author's account.
